summary: Your resume shows great initial marketing experience through your volunteer work and class projects. To make it more impactful, you should focus on quantifying your achievements and clearly connecting your technical skills to your experiences.
strengths: Direct marketing experience through social media management for a campus organization.
Practical academic project work involving primary research and teamwork.

gaps.why: The social media experience lists tasks like managing the page and making posts but lacks metrics. Adding the number of posts, follower growth, or engagement rates would make this section much stronger.

The marketing class project mentions conducting a survey but does not specify the scale. Including the number of respondents or the tools used to analyze the data would demonstrate your research capabilities.

Skills like Microsoft Excel and Canva are listed in the skills section but are not mentioned in your experience or project descriptions. Connecting these tools to your actual tasks shows how you apply them in practice.
